 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Infurmary"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Infirmary"**. (अस्पताल)

 
 
• **Example: **The school **infirmary** is well-equipped to handle minor injuries and illnesses.
 
 
 
• **"Infirmary" **refers to **a place in a large institution for the care of those who are ill. **(अस्पताल)
 
 
• **Example: **The old soldiers were taken to the infirmary for medical treatment.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dictionary** (शब्दकोश): A reference book on words, usually alphabetically arranged, containing their meanings and usage.

 
 
• **Example:** She consulted the **dictionary **to find the meaning of the new word.
 
 
 
• **Reference** (संदर्भ): The action of mentioning or alluding to something.
 
 
• **Example: **He made a **reference** to the previous meeting in his report.
 
 
 
• **Ordinary** (साधारण): With no special or distinctive features; normal.
 
 
• **Example:** She led an **ordinary** life, but she was happy and content.
